scheme_name: Marriage Grant to Orphan Daughter of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: The applicant must be a bona fide resident of Haryana.
The applicant must be a dependent orphan daughter of an ex‑serviceman.
Assistance is available for up to two orphan daughters of an ex‑serviceman.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹51,000 is provided for the marriage of each eligible orphan daughter.
